role: Independent QA: new tests, tools and reports only; product code owned by implementation agents.
user_problem: Coded actor/action/country labels do not tell an editor what happened and cannot support topic selection.
assessment: Real related-report headlines and excerpts are now the primary card content. Missing and failed content stays explicit; coding is secondary and never used to invent a report.

initial_focused_matrix.note: Predates the final bounded-Mentions refinement and small UI changes. Unchanged fetch/parser/budget paths are covered here.

final_affected_matrix.note: Frozen final product; includes independent VM work budgets for unique and same-batch timestamps, real PostgreSQL plans, cards, source worker, HTTP journey, selection and material handoff.

count_note: Phases and the whole-repository suite overlap. Do not add their pass totals.
independently_verified_behaviors: Local ArticleIdentity hash lookup supplies real saved headlines, excerpts and language on the first SSR/GET without background writes.
OfficialMention-only document association works; one document shared by multiple event codes is labelled a related-report lead, not a verified event assertion.
Real controlled HTTP goes through public-address validation and IP-pinned safe_fetch to the real parser, worker, cache and subsequent GET.
Tracking aliases share one durable job and preview; network fetches hold no checked-out SQL connection.
403/blocked HTML stays a visible content gap; an explicit retry can recover after the source becomes readable.
Selected title, excerpt, provenance and hashes freeze as TopicSource research leads; later cache updates do not change them.
Source-preview translation queues the visible real title and excerpt, freezes input, and uses a deterministic task-worker model stub.
Reading GETs are SQL-only and read-only, do not open the raw archive or HTTP/LLM, and the new card/status polling endpoints do not COUNT.
Page source lookup has bounded query count for 1 versus 30 events, uses ArticleIdentity IN lookups and narrow SQL substr fields, not full ArticleVersion/raw payloads or long-URL equality scans.
A newly arrived local Article wins over an in-flight remote preview without overwriting local news or creating a researched Event.
Foreign-Origin writes, arbitrary URL payload fields, oversized requests and invalid event identifiers are refused.
Durable retry caps, title-only supplementation, concurrent enqueue, lease expiry and stale-publisher fencing pass on both databases.
No-source and disabled-worker states remain explicit; coding-only records cannot fabricate report content.

checks: standard ports and no URL credentials
one absolute deadline across bounded DNS, headers, redirect hops and slow body
real local TLS hostname verification and detached-socket deadline interruption
security_and_budget_coverage.transport: Loopback-only synthetic HTTP/TLS; no public source or production service was contacted.

performance_issue_found_and_fixed.finding: Window ranking by confidence scanned and sorted all historical Mentions of a hot event to return only three previews.
performance_issue_found_and_fixed.fix: Card previews read at most 12 recent indexed candidates per event, then choose up to 3 in memory; detail reads at most 31 recent rows. Recency SQL omits unindexed key tie sorting.
performance_issue_found_and_fixed.query_scope: Confidence ranking is only within recent candidates, explicitly surfaced in response scope metadata; it is not all-history top confidence.

browser_evidence.note: Browser fetch/parser and translation task-worker flows use deterministic synthetic source/model stubs; the independent HTTP journey separately exercises the real safe-fetch transport.

whole_suite.note: Collected before final Mention refinements; final affected matrix above covers those changes.

limits: No real public news site, production database, production FalkorDB or real LLM provider was exercised; availability and translation quality of a user deployment remain outside this controlled QA.
Headlines and excerpts remain source-reading leads, not acquired fulltext or verification of a coded event. Source-only short drafting stays blocked.
Background discovery is deliberately bounded to the newest 60 events seen in seven days; manual current-page requests are prioritized. This does not assert full historical source enrichment.
Access-restricted, PDF and non-article sources may remain missing/title-only and require the later research/material-reading stage.
